title: Mixed Event — Resonating with you

meta.Outline: Ichika and the others learn that Shiho has been scouted by another band. Shiho is finally able to express what she's been feeling, but how will her bandmates respond?

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! You've been doing street performances, Ichi?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, Miku suggested that I needed to play in front of other people to get better.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, is that what Miku was talking about? Secret training equaled street performances?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I knew it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No wonder it felt like you were singing and playing so much better than before!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. It felt so good to drum along to that. Your voice carried so much more power and made us come together as one...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
She's right.
But it wasn't just Ichika. All of you have been working very hard.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Exactly. You've gotten much better too, Honami, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We have...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Teehee. We have Shiho to thank for that♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I still think you need more work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shihooo...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Everyone has definitely gotten a lot better. Ichika especially, and has that look in her eye when she sings now.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That STANDOUT show was so good. They looked like a band that was about to go pro and make it big.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (If only we could play like they did...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, isn't it about time we tried doing our own show?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, we've been practicing so hard. Don't you want other people to come see us perform?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'd like that too.
A show with all of us in it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It sounds fun, but I'm also a little scared...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've played in front of an audience during recitals with the brass band, but it'll be our first time playing as a band so...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I understand, Honami. I felt the same way until just recently...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then it all changed after I started doing street performances. It was so much fun having other people hear my music...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You'll feel nervous at first too, but I feel that you'll want to keep playing more and more after you give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. If you say so, Ichika, I'll give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Ichika's changed quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All thanks to Miku's secret training, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't do anything.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika did that all on her own.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, then it's settled! We're doing a show! But where is the next question...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I would say the School Festival, but that's still a long way off so...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (A show...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm happy that we've finally reached this point...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But is it okay for us to perform on stage just for fun like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyone have any good ideas...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, you work at a live house.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Would it be possible for us to play there? Maybe you could ask...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can we table that idea for now?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Shiho.
I know that we're still not playing at the level you'd like.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I believe that as long as we keep practicing, we'll become even better in time for our show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's not the issue.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I get that you've been working really hard and have actually gotten a lot better, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Everyone has, and we're playing better as a unit now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's something I need to deal with first...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, but I'm gonna need some time to myself.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I have to get to work too. Bye...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What's going on with Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Maybe I'm still not ready...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, it's not just you. I still haven't reached where she wants me to be yet either.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I feel like something else is bothering her.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's hard to say what's on Shiho's mind. It might be best for us to just wait and give her some time. We should still have time to talk to her after that, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, we might not know when we'll be doing our show right now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But how about we keep practicing so that we'll be ready to play whenever?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If we keep getting better, I'm sure she'll say yes to performing in a show with us too♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like someone's ready to go.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Of course!
Putting on a show with everyone is gonna be so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But what should we do to get stage ready?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Street performances together might be a little tough...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. Moving a drum kit around would be pretty rough and it'll probably be hard to find a good spot...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Practicing may not be the only key to getting better, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Seeing someone else perform can also give you a better idea of what you need to do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She's right. Shows are all about having the audience see you perform, so you have to think about what you want them to see.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You can check out how other bands sound and do just that by seeing their shows.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see. Come to think of it, we haven't really done that. We've just been practicing like there's no tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then how about we go see a show today?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, how about we go to that live house Shiho works at then?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. The fact that she has work today probably means someone is playing today too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sounds like a plan. Let's go!
Live House

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, sound check's done. Equipment setup's done...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All that's left is to wait for the band to get here, and today's lineup includes...
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
We're not open yet...
Wait, are you performing today?

Uh, yes! Excuse me!
I'm with STANDOUT...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Someone from STANDOUT...?
I didn't see this person last time, so maybe they're staff or something?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is something the matter?
Our bassist won't be able to make it today and we were hoping that you'd be able to play in her place during today's show...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: M-Me?
Yes, I understand that you can play a few of our songs.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, I mean...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can play what I know, but it's hardly anything I'd want other people to see.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: More notice in advance would've been preferable...

I... I'm sorry. I beg you.
Please, just for today...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: STANDOUT's not scheduled to come out until the end, right? I still sort of remember what they played last time, so if I start practicing now...

Th-Thank you so much!
Here's the sheet music...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, fine.
Please, just don't let this happen again.
I'm so sorry...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
What's going on...?
Not being able to make it all the sudden...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe they came down with something... Anyways...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I-Iori...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
I hate to do this to you but...
Would you be a dear and sub in as the bassist for our show today...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, I already heard and was given some sheet music. Your bassist isn't able to make it today?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Can't make it...?
Who did you hear that from?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not sure, but she looked around your age, Iori.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Mind if I take a look at those?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, sure. Here...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I knew it, these are Mio's. After promising to get ready for this show too...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: She just isn't ready to try and make it as a pro. At this rate, we're gonna need a...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Anyways, thanks for doing this. We'll adjust our setlist to include song that you can play.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I want us to play our best together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I know...
Everyone coming today has been looking forward to seeing you play...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Yeah... True...
You're a lifesaver.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow, everyone so far has been so good...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right?! Everybody here's having so much fun! I can't wait to do a show with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The next band's probably the last one, right? I feel like there's way more people here now than before...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I saw the lineup for today. The last band is supposed to be one of the more popular ones out there right now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
They're called STANDOUT.
They're even about to debut with a major label.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! They're signed to a major label?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We need to learn everything we can from them for Shiho's sake!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's do just that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, here they come.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They're so cool.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They are.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (What an incredible performance, and this girl's singing on a completely different level than me...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This is what professionals sound like...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Gasp*...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, Ichi, Hona!
Is that Shiho playing bass up there?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It is...!
She looks so cool!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But why's she playing with them...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It could be that their regular bassist couldn't make it today, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! She subs in for other bands sometimes, right♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
They sound amazing too.
I don't think I can ever sing like that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to put on a show like this with everyone...
Outside the live house

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: STANDOUT was sooo amazing!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And Shiho played so well too. It's like she was a completely different person up there.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's do just that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I also learned a lot about what we'll need to put on our own show too, like MC'ing and how to get the crowd excited...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehehe. Ichi's gonna be our MC?
I can't wait to see that♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
M-Me? Oh, right...
The frontman usually does all the talking, but what am I supposed to talk about...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What if you talked about any yakisoba buns you want to recommend to everyone, or how Honami likes apple pies so much?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But Shiho might say, Don't get ahead of yourself. Keep practicing!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Was that supposed to sound like her?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's cute.
Maybe we should actually ask Shiho herself?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I might burst into tears laughing if she gives the same response.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hahaha♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But where is she anyway...?
She should've gotten off work by now...
Hinomori, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Voice
rows.Line: I said we're done talking...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Is that Shiho?
Something feels wrong...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Enough about me joining STANDOUT...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What's going on...?
Outside the live house

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, what was that about...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: So these are your bandmates?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? We're, uh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're Leo/need, the band Shiho currently plays in...!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Okay, now I see.
I'm Iori of STANDOUT. Nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: N-Nice to meet you...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't mean to scare you or anything.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, um... It's just that...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah, about what you just heard...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I've been trying to get Hinomori to play for STANDOUT.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: We're all set for our big debut, but then our bassist sort of just fell through.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Then I found Hinomori. She's sounds amazing and even wants to go pro...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I hate to do this to you, but I've taken the liberty of doing some recruiting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But she's already in Leo/need.
You can't just take her away from us...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah, I get that she means a lot to you guys. You wouldn't be here right now if she wasn't...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hinomori wants to go pro, so this is probably too good an opportunity for her to pass up.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: If she joins us, her dream will come true. We already know just how good she is and I'm confident that she'll just keep growing alongside us.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: That's why I want her in STANDOUT.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: W-Wait! If we get good enough, we can show everybody just how good Shiho is too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know she has fun playing in a band with us...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I, um...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I understand that you want to keep playing with your friends. I can tell that you've been through a lot together...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But it's not like they're focused on becoming professionals too, right? Your band right now is something they're doing for fun.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: If you come with me, we can chase after the same dream. We can walk the same path...
I-Iori...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? You're...?
I'm sorry about what happened today...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Mio? What are you doing here?
The show's already over.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I know...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: STANDOUT needs people that actually want to go pro.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: We need people that can give each show everything they have and put on the best performance possible, not cowards that turn their tails and run.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Next week, we're gonna announce that we'll be debuting with a major label at Shibuya Park's outdoor stage.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Debuting...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: If you're that serious about becoming a pro, Hinomori, we'll be waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: With open arms.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Iori...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sorry about not telling you guys...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This actually isn't the first time she tried to get me to join her...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is this why you seemed a little down compared to normal...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But you're not going, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're staying with us gonna keep our band together, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I have a dream...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I want to go pro and play music that can touch people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's what I want to do...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's never really changed for you, has it, Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's a part of me that was hoping we'd all be able to pursue that dream together...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But not all of you want to become professional musicians...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm finally starting to understand what you mean by music that touches people's hearts!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to practice more and learn how to be as good as you, Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I appreciate that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But do you think that means you want to go pro too...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You'll have to spend even more time practicing, rehearsing and fine tuning your sound to actually make it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Going shopping after school or visiting PXL together won't be possible anymore...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And even if you manage to go pro, your life will end up revolving around music. School, friends, everything will change...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is that what you want?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: See? There's other stuff you all want to do...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not about to force you into doing something you don't want to do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Force...
Don't say that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We want to play with you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We want to be in a band with you!
Forever and ever...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, I appreciate the thought, but that's just not enough...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You have to be willing to put everything on the line to become a pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can you say for sure that you'd be able to do that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Put everything on the line...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I, uh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry for causing such a fuss...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: S-Shiho, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I couldn't tell her...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I couldn't say that I'd be willing to do that for her...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Please don't cry, Saki...
I couldn't tell her either...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Hona...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (What are we supposed to do...?)
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Morning, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... Can you come to practice today? We were thinking about trying out a new song...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, I have to work again today...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll keep practicing and make sure that we'll be ready for when you can make it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's go. We're gonna be late.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, right...
Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Ichika's been trying so hard lately too, and gotten so much better...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Everyone else too. They put up with everything I made them do...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, I appreciate the thought, but that's just not enough...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You have to be willing to put everything on the line to become a pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can you say for sure that you'd be able to do that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Put everything on the line...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I, uh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I think I made Saki cry too...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (If I let her finish, she might've actually said that she wants to go pro too...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But thoughts alone won't be enough. She'll absolutely end up regretting that decision...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I don't want her to feel that way ever again...)
Live House

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There doesn't seem to be anything special going on with today's show so...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Um, Hinomori...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? You're...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Yes, my name is Mio. I'm the bassist for STANDOUT...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I'd like to apologize about the other day. I feel terrible about making you play in my place like that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was a little startled, but at least everything ended up going smoothly.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: More to the point, is there something going on between you and Iori...?

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: After it became clear that we'd be making our big debut, I became scared and started avoiding everyone...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Scared?

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Iori said that after we turn pro, we'll have to invest much more time and really commit to our music...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: For the longest time, I just wanted to have fun while playing in a band...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: We all came up with songs together, played in shows and really seemed to be enjoying it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(She's almost the same as Ichika.
Having fun with everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Iori told me that having fun or just liking music won't be enough when we go pro.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: She said that we'd have to put our music and fans first above anything else. She said that we'd be responsible for how they feel.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I just couldn't understand what she meant by that. Is there something wrong with just playing whatever music we like...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This responsibility she's talking about may be about playing your best whenever you're on stage. At least, that's what I think...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Playing your best...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It doesn't matter if you don't feel well or become sick, your audience will be waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's also the staff that help make your shows happen. You'd be putting all their hard work to waste as well.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I... I didn't realize I was being so selfish...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I was so scared that everything would change. I was worried that I wouldn't be able to play music with Iori and everyone else like we have been...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She really is the same. This is probably what'll end up happening to everyone else too...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Going from playing in a band for fun to playing professionally would be too big a leap of faith for most people...)

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I still want to be in a band with them. I want to keep walking the same path as Iori...!

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I kept running away and ended up disappointing Iori but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I want to go pro and get better.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I want to play music that can really move people, like that band can.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess I do really like being in a band with them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I see a part of me within her too...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The part that still wants to be in a band with my friends...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd like to give this back to you...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Huh? My sheet music...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll need these if you want to keep playing for STANDOUT.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I... I'm so sorry. After she spent so much time recruiting you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Please, don't worry about that.
It was never mine to keep anyway.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I do agree with Iori about rethinking what you want to do moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Right. About our responsibility as professionals...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly. As long as you're willing to invest a little more time into your music, I think you'll be just fine.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you don't think you can keep up with Iori or feel like you'll end up disappointing her even further, you may want to find something else to do.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you came this far and even got a record deal. That mean's you're at least that good.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Hinomori...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Thank you so much...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Break a leg.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I hope things turn out well...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now, it's my turn...
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
Shiho can't make it today either.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. She said she's busy with work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Quit apologizing and let's practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I do want to get better, but together... With all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What was going through her mind while she was working with each us of...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But she did say that she wants to get better, together...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She did...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I felt the same way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I thought we'd be able to hang out more too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I wonder what it's like to go pro.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wouldn't know. It always felt like those people lived in a completely different world than us...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The first time Shiho told me that she wanted to go pro, I thought that it would be sort of nice if I could as well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I always knew that it wasn't really possible. I don't think I ever actually wanted to...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This mindset is what's causing her so much pain.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You're not alone, Ichika.
I fell into the same trap...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I want to be in a band with her. I don't want her to leave us for some other band...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That I know is true...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I guess that's not enough for her...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right...
If we aren't ready to actually start working towards becoming pros ourselves, we'll just end up hurting Shiho more.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So if we're getting in the way of Shiho's dream coming true...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Should we break up our band...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't know...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Becoming a pro, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Are they going to be okay?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They're definitely between a rock and hard place. I'm not even sure what to tell them right now...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And Shiho may be going through the same thing right now as well...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
They care about each other so much...
But that's also what makes this so hard...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, Miku...
Do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Do you know what it means...?
What's needed to become a pro...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I haven't stopped thinking about it ever since Shiho told us about that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Becoming a pro...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm not sure I can say since I'm not a professional myself...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But maybe it has something to do with constantly trying to understand what your music is about...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Understanding our music?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is that it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, there has to be more to it than that! What about having to push the other things you want to do to the side and stuff...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That I can't say...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not even Miku can answer this one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course. I've never thought about turning pro or how to do it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can at least say that I don't think resolve and commitment aren't things you can learn about from others.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So we have to find that answer ourselves...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku.
Music Shop

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Understanding our music, huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I sort of get it but not really...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Do we not know how to do that yet...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Maybe. As much as we've been practicing, I'm not sure we've reached that level of understanding yet...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, hey...! A STANDOUT CD.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right. They're being featured as a one of the hottest indie bands out there right now. I guess they are just that famous.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Music that moves people...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Shiho probably wants to perform just the way they did...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But there's no way we can match them right now. Maybe we should let Shiho be free and pursue her dream with STANDOUT...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If Shiho joins them, she could actually make it and debut as a pro...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But what if she starts drifting away from us...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm sure we can still see each other. We can still be friends, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I can't let that happen...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I want us to stay together...
I want us four to be in a band...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're right!
We have to tell her that!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree. I wouldn't have it any other way.
But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho's probably thinking long and hard about which path she wants to take too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We can't go into this half-hearted. She needs to clearly know how we feel and what we plan to do about it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We need to think about what it really means to go pro, and if we're willing to make that commitment...
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You'll have to spend even more time practicing, rehearsing and fine tuning your sound to actually make it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Going shopping after school or visiting PXL together won't be possible anymore...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Shiho must've said that because she knows that there's a ton of stuff that I want to do...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (She's not wrong either. I missed out on so much while I was in the hospital...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But I still...)
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Commitment...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's so hard to say what'll happen if we do decide to do this...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But Shiho's been thinking about this her entire life.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (She's never wavered. She always has that look in her eye...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I believe that deciding to do something means you're choosing to give up on something else at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So you have to be ready to accept that people will dislike you for your decisions. That's normal.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What I'm trying to say is... Just do what you think is right.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (What I think is right...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think...
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Becoming a pro...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Can I really commit to that?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Is it okay for someone that's lived a completely ordinary life to just turn around and say that...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So that my music can really get them going too...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But maybe it has something to do with constantly trying to understand what your music is about...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Understanding our music...
The day of the STANDOUT show
Show Venue - Backstage

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
All of the equipment looks good.
Thanks, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: We're all set to put on an awesome show.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (All that's left is to wait for...)

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Iori...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (If only she just took the plunge and...)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: No, I promised myself that I'd stop thinking about that...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (Nothing good would probably have happened if I forced her back into playing for us...)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (We're not doing this for fun anymore. We have to always be at our best now as pros...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Iori...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Oh... Hi, Hinomori...
Thanks for stopping by during your day off like this.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Would you mind playing for us again?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Isn't Mio supposed to be coming...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She may still be a little lost, but she'll at the very least come tell you how she feels.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So let's wait just a little longer...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: No, we don't have that kind of time. We need to keep moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: And I don't want her to suffer any more than she has to...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: It'll make things easier for me if she doesn't show up...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Now, back our little discussion.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: If you do decide that you want to join us, I'd like to introduce you to everyone as our new bassist at the end of the show.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: How's that sound...?
Wait...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You guys...!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hey, it's authorized personnel only here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're very sorry about barging in like this...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But please, give us a moment with her...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Please!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Fine. What is it?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There's something we need to tell Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Before you make your decision, please listen to what we have to say first...
Show Venue - Backstage

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, what's this you have to say?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We took a long look at ourselves after we last talked and thought about what we want to do.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The three of us came up with an answer and we want you to know that we're serious about this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: S-Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I thought about it for a really long time and still felt that I want to be in a band with you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know that you'll start being even harder on us during practice and that we won't have time for much else.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I'm still not sure if I can commit to trying to become a pro yet...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I want us to be in a band together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I really love playing with you too, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Even though I was terrible at the drums in the beginning, you took the time to teach me during practice and I've become more confident in my abilities.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, you could've done that all on your own. All I did was go over the basics with you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That may be true, but that's not the only thing I learned from you, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For the longest time, Shiho, all I could do was worry about my own well being and it bothered me so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But you were the one that helped me overcome that and move forward...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't do...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're wrong. I definitely wouldn't have been able to if it weren't for you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You taught me that kindness isn't just about pandering to someone's needs.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's why we all made the decision to come here and tell you exactly how we feel.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, I'm sorry for not realizing this sooner.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Until now, I thought I was satisfied with just being in a band together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I thought that it would be nice to go pro and it felt like I was supporting your dream without understanding what I was actually doing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That mindset is what ended up hurting you the most. It kept holding you back...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But then I thought about it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When I saw you performing with them the other day, I realized something...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to play music that can move people with you, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When I was doing street performances, I felt like I was reaching some of the people that stopped by to watch me play.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I thought that this is sort of what you meant by what you said then...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're nowhere near as good as STANDOUT right now, but someday, maybe we can reach that level, together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm still not sure what it means to commit to trying to become a pro...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I know that I want to be in a band with you, Shiho. I want to perform in shows with you. I want our others to be moved by our music...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If that means aiming to become professionals, so be it...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks...
I understand now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't want you to bear that burden...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Burden? No, don't say that!
We just...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I'm so jealous...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: You're something else, Hinomori...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Getting others mixed up in your dreams.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Worrying about what'll happen to your friends or if it's even okay for you to put them through something like this...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But I get where you're coming from.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, I...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: How about I make a suggestion?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Play one song, right here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't understand.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hinomori's got it in her head that it's not okay for her to force you into pursuing the same dream as her.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: She thinks it's unfair to do so and is worried about what'll happen.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: So it's your chance to tell her that you can handle it.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Tell her that you're absolutely ready to walk this path by playing her something.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Are you sure?
This is such an important day for your band...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: True. We can't really have you perform with us so...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: How does being our opening act sound?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Iori...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But you won't have much time to get ready.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Yes or no.
I need to know right now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's so nice of them to lend us their instruments.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And they come pre-tuned.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They're gonna be used in a show, so they sort of need to be...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.
But who would've thought that we'd be doing our first show as a band like this...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
This place is huge too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's like we're in a dream.
I can't believe this is happening...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So which song are we doing...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
What should we do?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
How about a Miku song?
Like the one we first played?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that one!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. We were all over the place back then, and Shiho was so mad that we fell apart just the way she said we would.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But she taught us so much after that, so we should be good now! I don't even need the sheet music for it anymore!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You sound so confident.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, are you okay...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm fine.
How about you, Ichika...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm a little nervous.
This being our first show and all...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But I'm excited too.
We finally get to do this together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You were so amazing that time you performed with STANDOUT.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm just happy that I get to be up here with you now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's give it everything we have, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right back at you...
Show Venue

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Hm? What's going on?
I thought only STANDOUT was playing today?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: You know who they are?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Nope, never seen them before...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone!
We're Leo/need! It's great to see you here!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Today, we'll be the opening performance for STANDOUT's big show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'd like to play the song that brought us together as a band, and hope that you'll listen...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh no, my hands are starting to shake...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This is totally different from doing a street performance. I can't tell if my voice is reaching them...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Everyone else sounds so far away for some reason too...)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: You'd think STANDOUT would have a better opening act, right?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
They sound pretty amateurish.
Not really getting our money's worth...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They look disappointed...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (How can Iori do this to them? Making them perform in public for the first time on this big a stage...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Everyone's starting to freeze up too. It feels like they're letting the audience control the agenda...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We won't be able to recover if this keeps up...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (No, this isn't working...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It's our first show as Leo/need too...! It's our chance to tell Shiho how we truly feel...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We can't give up! We need to tell her...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This song, this performance has to reach her!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Ichika...?!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Ichika...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Right, I need to keep up with her...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm the pillar that supports this band.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Ichi...! Hona...! They sound amazing!
Way better than they do in practice...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm not giving up either...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We have to get through this song and tell Shiho how we really feel...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Ichika got Honami and Saki to bounce back... They never had this kind of power during practice...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(They are serious...
It's so easy to tell...)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Hm? They sound better now!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Yeah! That's more like it!
Who were they again?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're getting into it.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Alright, time to follow through...!)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Not bad.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We did it...)
Show Venue - Backstage

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That was so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was nervous at first, but that went really well!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I didn't know you could sing like that.
It was incredible...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And you two did really well too, Saki, Honami. Especially considering this was your first show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I made a couple mistakes, but doing a show with you like this was so much fun...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, we were being serious...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you wait all this time. You're not alone anymore...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I hope you'll have us...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're serious about trying to go pro?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't come crying to me if anything happens.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's never going to happen!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's make our dreams come true, as Leo/need!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I guess that makes me the loser...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (If only she could say the same thing. No, she might not be ready yet...)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Well, time to scout a new member.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Iori...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: M-Mio...?

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I'm sorry for avoiding you this whole time. I was so scared about what would happen after we went pro...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: But I'm ready. I'm done running. I'll do everything I can for this band, so please, let me come back...!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: What took you so long...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I deserve some of the blame too, but do you know how much trouble you caused us and the staff?

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I'm so sorry. I really am...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: But I want us to perform together. I know that I was being selfish, but I want us to keep playing as STANDOUT!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Prove it during our show...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, everyone!!
Now, let's get this show started!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's her...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm glad she came back...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, nothing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Get ready for some tough practices starting tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Uh oh!
Here come Shiho the tyrant!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's keep practicing and work towards putting on another show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd like that too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That sounds nice...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we'll have to start making our own songs too if we're gonna actually go pro. Just keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! We'll have to start thinking about that...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Our own songs...!
I bet Shiho can come up with some without even trying!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If only it were so easy...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we can all think about that together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right. Let's make as many as we can.
The four of us, together!
